about.purpose: Every fee note goes out when it falls due, and clients pay within 30 days. Brian and Aisha follow up the clients, and Njeri raises the fee notes and records what is paid.

stageNeeds.text: Due: the date or event in the engagement letter has passed.
Promised: the client gave a date.
Paid: with a slip, M-Pesa message or receipt.

risks.text: A court event that makes a fee note due, with no fee note raised.
A promised date that passes without payment.
